details: Android app, nicFW950 profile over BLE (FFE1, MTU 23, write-without-response session). Driver sends nicFW read aa 30 00 02 05 00 00 (block 0x50200); radio returns 0 of 135 bytes after 15 s; unchanged-block probe fails the same way. BLE link itself is healthy. Most likely the radio runs stock Radtel firmware (nicFW-only command; same pattern as INBOX:781). The mobile app offers Bluetooth only for nicFW950; stock RT-950 Pro is USB cable only. Over BLE the first exchange is the block read, so the friendly 'not running nicFW950' message from the serial baud handshake never appears.
summary: Android Bluetooth read: no reply to nicFW950 block read
